translation: One must know that the quarter of the southwest is the Kun region: in front of the coccyx, behind the bladder, below the small intestine, and above the spiritual turtle (linggui) — this is the place that heaven and earth daily generate, the region where the qi-root produces lead (qian), [but] the physicians do not know that this exists. Binhu said: When the alchemical books discuss the yang essence and the Heche (River Cart, the alchemical conveyance), they all typically speak of the Ren, Chong, and Du meridians, the Mingmen, and the Sanjiao, and there has never been one that points directly at the Yin Qiao.
